svg.text: ⚓ OwnerShip: you shipped it. But do you own it?
Hey @octocat! Before this PR sets sail, here are 3 questions about your changes.
No timer, no leaderboard. Every answer, right or wrong, gets an explanation.
1. Why retry only on 429, 502, 503 and 504, and not on every 5xx?
• A. Every 5xx is a server bug, so retrying would only add load.
• B. These statuses mean "try again later"; a plain 500 usually does not.
• C. The fetch API cannot read the status of other 5xx responses.
• D. Retrying a 500 would break the idempotency of POST requests.
2. What happens if Retry-After is a date instead of a number of seconds? …
- [x] ⚓ Dead Reckoning: I answered without AI help
